Legacy campaign

Beyond the Dynamo (1902–1921)

Electricity is becoming a bigger business. Grow the customer base without leaving your successor a pile of debt.

Explore the Legacy campaign↗ See what’s at stake ↓

Build one utility across nine generations. This chapter is part of that journey.

Location
A fictional California utility
Starts in
1902
Generation
20 years

The situation

Your starting point

Beyond the Dynamo is the second Legacy generation, reached by continuing the company founded in First Light. Your opening fleet and finances depend on the decisions made during that first term.

The goal now is growth. Reach more customers as electricity demand rises, while keeping end-of-term debt within the published allowance. Extra sales are useful only if the utility can afford the system needed to serve them.

The choices

What will you do?

  1. 01

    Give new customers enough supply

    Plan construction alongside customer growth. Winning more accounts creates a new obligation to keep their electricity reliable.

  2. 02

    Finance expansion carefully

    Weigh borrowing against the revenue new capacity can earn. The campaign checks the debt you leave at the end of your term.

  3. 03

    Work with the inherited company

    Review existing plants before ordering replacements. Some early investments may still be useful; others will need a plan before the next handover.

Put your plan to the test

Continue from First Light and decide what responsible growth looks like for your company.

Open the campaign setup to begin, or continue your existing company. Later generations inherit the choices you made before them.
